Positive Perron eigenvector and strict ball preference prove every equality case. The standalone exact checker successfully replayed.

value.rationale: C5 is the first odd cycle beyond the complete graph, a natural minimal benchmark for extending the published complete/star strong Hilbert norm theory. The maximizing nonlinear operator activates all three available radii in a unique dihedral class, rather than one fixed linear averaging scale. The exact cubic and complete equality moduli provide a reusable structural benchmark for discrete maximal inequality research; this is a natural complete finite classification rather than a contrived parameter slice. No extension to all cycles is inferred.
